reason: 2026-09-20: Restore the CSRF cookie's parent domain at the gateway. The account worker writes Domain=packone.pro on __Secure-pack1_csrf, but the Neon runtime strips a Domain its own host does not own, so the cookie reached browsers host-only to api.packone.pro. The page on packone.pro therefore could not read the double-submit token, hasAccountSession stayed false, and every account write was refused as unverified even though the session itself is now delivered correctly. api.packone.pro is a subdomain of packone.pro, so the gateway can legitimately set that attribute and now does on relay. __Host- cookies are untouched, since a Domain would invalidate them. Gateway-only change; the Neon functions redeploy at the same reviewed revision.
